title: Options Trading in 7 Minutes (How to Make $100 DAY As A Beginner)
summary: A former trading intern pitches buying calls and puts on momentum and before earnings to make about $100 a day from a small account.

assertions.quote: I use daily to make over a hundred dollars a day even when I had a few thousand dollars to my name

verdicts.note: Most retail options buyers lose money, and a steady daily income from a few thousand dollars implies returns far beyond any documented sustained performance.

assertions.quote: if you have a small account buying call options can make you very wealthy very quickly
you can actually have a double on your money very short term and this is a very proven strategy

verdicts.note: Implied volatility is bid up before earnings and collapses after the announcement, so pre-earnings option buyers lose on average.

assertions.quote: I recommend that if you want the largest return in the quickest amount of time that you will buy call options before earnings
your chances of ending in the money and actually making a profit is again going to be higher than 50 percent

verdicts.note: Delta roughly approximates the chance of expiring in the money, not of clearing the premium paid, so the probability of profit is lower than delta.

assertions.quote: when you see momentum like this starting you can jump in with a call option and ride the price action higher

verdicts.note: Short-term momentum and gap patterns offer at most weak edges that option premiums and spreads absorb; most retail option buyers lose.

assertions.quote: you get a lot of Leverage you can control 100 shares without having to Fork up all that Capital
you should only trade what you're willing to lose
